name: acr-chat
description: Stop unverified agent edits in local workflows. Official ACR suite with a local One Dashboard, W3C Ed25519 did:key verification, 67% Consensus Gate reference tallies, Atlas 2.0 Dynamic DAG rollback checkpoints, $0 Runtime Protocol Tax under Apache-2.0, and hosted Cloud OAuth commands. Bundled local bridge has no live daemon connection.

daemonUrl.title: ACR Daemon URL
